ask_first.en: Any stiff neck, rash, fits, or breathing trouble?

comfort_measures.en: Rest in a cool, ventilated room
Drink plenty of clean fluids (boiled and cooled water, ORS, rice water, soup)
Wear light clothing. Remove extra blankets
Lukewarm (not cold) sponging of the forehead and body can feel soothing

avoid.en: Giving any medicine without asking a pharmacist or health worker

see_doctor_if.en: Fever lasting more than 2 days, or at any time with severe headache, stiff neck, rash, trouble breathing, persistent vomiting, confusion or fits
In and after the monsoon, fever with chills, body pain or severe headache can be malaria or dengue. Do not wait it out. Get tested at the nearest health centre

care_time_limit.en: Seek care if fever lasts more than 2 days; seek care earlier for the listed warning signs

ask_first.en: Any breathing difficulty, chest pain, wheezing, or coughing blood?

comfort_measures.en: Rest and warm fluids (warm water, soup)
Gargle with warm salt water for sore throat
Steam inhalation only for adults, carefully, with no hot water near children
Keep the head slightly raised when sleeping

avoid.en: Giving honey to infants under 1 year

see_doctor_if.en: Cough lasting more than 2 weeks (needs TB checking), breathing difficulty, fast breathing in a child, chest pain, coughing blood, or high fever lasting more than 2 days

go_now_if.en: Breathing difficulty, chest pain, or coughing blood

care_time_limit.en: Seek care for a cough lasting more than 2 weeks, or high fever lasting more than 2 days; seek help earlier for the listed warning signs

ask_first.en: Did the headache start suddenly rather than gradually?
Any fever, stiff neck, vomiting, vision change, weakness, head injury, or confusion?

comfort_measures.en: Rest in a quiet, dim room
Drink water. Many headaches are linked to dehydration or missed meals
A cool cloth on the forehead or neck
Gentle neck and shoulder stretching

avoid.en: Giving any medicine without advice from a pharmacist or doctor

see_doctor_if.en: Headaches that keep returning for several days

go_now_if.en: Sudden severe headache, headache after a head injury, with fever and stiff neck, with vomiting, vision change, weakness or confusion

care_time_limit.en: Seek care for headaches that keep returning for several days; the exact deadline needs clinician review. Get help now for the listed emergency signs

comfort_measures.en: ORS (oral rehydration solution): mix exactly as the packet says, using clean boiled and cooled water, and give small, frequent sips
Continue breastfeeding for babies and normal eating when possible
Wash hands with soap before eating and after the toilet

avoid.en: Fizzy drinks, packaged juices, unboiled water, stopping food completely. Giving anti-diarrhoea medicines without advice

see_doctor_if.en: Blood in stool, loose motions more than 2 days, cannot keep fluids down, very sleepy, sunken eyes, very dry mouth, or little or no urine. Children, elderly and pregnant women should be seen early

go_now_if.en: Blood in stool, very sleepy, sunken eyes, cannot drink, or no urine for 8 hours or more

care_time_limit.en: Seek care for loose motions lasting more than 2 days; seek help earlier for the listed warning signs

comfort_measures.en: Rest, then sip small amounts of ORS or clean water often
Once vomiting settles, start with plain foods (rice, banana, toast)

avoid.en: Oily, spicy food, large meals, alcohol

see_doctor_if.en: Vomiting blood, severe or worsening belly pain, cannot keep any fluid down for more than 12 to 24 hours, signs of dehydration, or vomiting after a head injury

go_now_if.en: Vomiting blood, cannot drink, severe dehydration, or vomiting after a head injury

care_time_limit.en: Seek care if unable to keep any fluid down for more than 12 to 24 hours; seek help earlier for the listed warning signs

ask_first.en: Is the cut deep or gaping?
Caused by dirty metal, an animal, or soil?

comfort_measures.en: Press firmly with a clean cloth for 10 minutes to stop bleeding
Rinse with clean running water and mild soap
Cover with a clean dry bandage and change it daily

avoid.en: Putting soil, ash, turmeric paste, or other home powders on an open wound

see_doctor_if.en: Bleeding that won't stop, deep or gaping wound, animal or human bite, rusty or dirty object, or signs of infection (spreading redness, pus, swelling, fever). Ask a health worker about tetanus protection

go_now_if.en: Bleeding that won't stop with firm pressure

care_time_limit.en: Seek care for the listed warning signs. This draft does not specify a waiting deadline for a minor cut; clinician clarification is required

ask_first.en: Was the burn caused by a chemical or electricity rather than fire or hot liquid?
Is it larger than the person's palm?
Is it on the face, hands, feet or private parts?
Is it small and superficial, rather than deep, white or blackened?

comfort_measures.en: Hold under cool, not ice-cold, running water for about 20 minutes
Remove rings and tight items before swelling starts
Cover loosely with a clean non-fluffy cloth

avoid.en: Ice, butter, oil, toothpaste, ink or home powders. Bursting blisters

see_doctor_if.en: Burns larger than the person's palm, on the face, hands, feet or private parts, deep or white or blackened burns, chemical or electrical burns, or any burn in a baby, child or elderly person (go now)

go_now_if.en: Burns larger than the person's palm, on the face, hands, feet or private parts, deep or white or blackened burns, chemical or electrical burns, or any burn in a baby, child or elderly person

care_time_limit.en: Go now for the listed warning signs. This draft does not specify a waiting deadline for a minor burn; clinician clarification is required

ask_first.en: Any deformity, numbness or severe swelling?

comfort_measures.en: Rest the area
Cool cloth for 15 to 20 minutes at a time in the first 1 to 2 days
Gentle compression with a bandage, not too tight
Raise the limb above heart level

avoid.en: Massaging a fresh injury hard, walking on it if painful

see_doctor_if.en: Cannot bear weight, obvious deformity, numbness, severe swelling, or no improvement in 3 days

care_time_limit.en: Seek care if there is no improvement in 3 days; seek help earlier for the listed warning signs

ask_first.en: Was the person in the sun or doing heavy work?

comfort_measures.en: Move to shade or a cool place, loosen clothing
Sip water or ORS slowly
Cool the skin with a wet cloth or fan

avoid.en: Going back to work in the heat the same day

see_doctor_if.en: Confusion, fainting, very high body temperature, hot dry skin with no sweating (emergency, possible heatstroke), or no improvement within 30 to 60 minutes

go_now_if.en: Confusion, fainting, very high body temperature, or hot dry skin with no sweating

care_time_limit.en: Seek care if there is no improvement within 30 to 60 minutes; get help now for the listed emergency signs
